jsonld_raw.name: ORCHIDÉE LUMIÈRE CAR AIR FRESHENER
jsonld_raw.description:
Car air freshener with a clip.

ORCHIDÉE LUMIÈRE | The orchid flower exhales a sensual and mysterious fragrance, where facets of black vanilla envelop an elegant floral bouquet and add a final touch of rich warmth.

Notes:
Top notes: citrus cocktail, Italian lemon oil, fruity.
Heart: orchid, Egyptian jasmine, lily of the valley, freesia, gardenia.
Base notes: wood, cedar, cedar oil, musk, vanilla.
